criteria: Recovery change request is APPROVED by someone other than the requester
Sales order item status is OPEN
Current plant equals the plant recorded when the request was approved
New plant produces the item's material category (Plant produces Material Category)
effects: Sets S/4HANA sales order item ProductionPlant (VBAP-WERKS) to the new plant
Writes a change document (VERKBELEG / VBAP-WERKS) under the approver's name

actions.description: Move an open sales order item to another production plant in S/4HANA, so a customer is supplied from a plant with capacity when its usual plant is disrupted. Changes VBAP-WERKS through API_SALES_ORDER_SRV. The recognized operation for executing a recovery reroute; acts on Sales Order.
actions.name: Reassign Delivering Plant

criteria: Approver is not the requester (segregation of duties)
All three acknowledgements are given and the confirmation phrase is POST TO S4HANA
effects: Sets the change request to APPROVED or REJECTED
Records the approver, acknowledgements, confirmation, comment, Snowflake user and role

actions.description: Record a governed decision to apply a recovery change request to the S/4HANA transactional system. The approver confirms they have reviewed every change and understand it alters live sales and planning documents. Required before any recovery Action can post.
actions.name: Approve Recovery Change Request

criteria: Recovery change request is APPROVED by someone other than the requester
Quantity is no more than the plant's spare units, less planned orders already created
effects: Creates an S/4HANA planned order (PLAF, order type LA) at the plant
Writes a change document (PLAF insert) under the approver's name

actions.description: Create a planned order in S/4HANA at the receiving plant for the quantity a recovery reroute moves there, so production planning covers the reassigned demand. Posts A_PlannedOrder through API_PLANNED_ORDERS. Acts on Plant.
actions.name: Create Planned Order
